# Mayor &amp; City Council

MAYOR ART SMYTH**[Art Smyth](mailto:brewstermayor1@frontier.com)**

**Mayor**

The mayor is responsible for the day-to-day administration of city affairs and conducts monthly council meetings. The mayor is also in charge of employing, disciplining, and dismissing department heads and employees. The mayor is elected for a four-year term.

Please call us for the mayor's email address.

[Approved Council Minutes](https://www.cityofbrewsterwashington.org/government/agendas_minutes.php)

**COUNCIL MEETING**

Council meeting dates have been changed to the Third Thursday of the Month at 6:00 pm. Check the News List on the homepage for exact dates.

**MAILING/PHYSICAL ADDRESS**

City of Brewster  
P.O. Box 340  
105 South 3rd Street  
Brewster, WA 98812

[CONTACT US](https://www.cityofbrewsterwashington.org/contact_us/index.php)**Phone:** (509) 689-3464
